note: The whole file validates against a type `user.seam` does not declare. That is the only way to reach `unknown_type` from a .seam file: the parser rejects a dangling reference inside a schema at parse time, so the name can only go wrong where the caller supplies it.

cases.name: a type the schema does not declare is unknown_type
cases.note: Reported at the root, not at the name: `path` is a route through the payload and a type name is not a key of anything. Reported as an issue with a code, not as a generic failure. A binding may detect it when the validator is bound rather than when a payload arrives, which is earlier and better, but the code must be the same either way.
